about.label: About
about.headline: Hi, I'm Alec.
paragraphs: I made AI Hub to keep my prompts and personas in one place and to share them. It is a personal project, so the collection is small and changes when I add to it.
If you have a prompt that works well, you can send it in.

items.question: What is this?
items.answer: A collection of AI prompts and personas, plus a few posts about using them. Everything is on this site and there is no account to make.

items.question: How do I use a prompt?
items.answer: Open a prompt, press copy, and paste it into your AI tool. On templates, fill in the fields first and the prompt text updates to match.

items.question: Are the prompts free to use?
items.answer: Yes. You can use, change and share them for personal or commercial work. Credit is appreciated but not required.

items.question: Which AI tools do they work with?
items.answer: Each prompt is tagged with the tool it was written for, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor or MidJourney. They may behave differently in other tools.

items.question: Can I contribute a prompt?
items.answer: Yes. Use the submit a prompt page. I decide what gets added.

items.question: Can I ask for a prompt?
items.answer: Yes, send a request with the contact form. I can't promise when or whether I will write it.

items.question: Can I run my own copy of this site?
items.answer: Yes. The site is open source. The DIY Prompt Library page has the details.
